## Brief: acme-robotics.io

acme-robotics.io was registered in 2019 via Namecheap to the org Acme Robotics Ltd (registrant privacy-protected). Active subdomains include api.acme-robotics.io, mail.acme-robotics.io and staging.acme-robotics.io; the mail host resolves to 203.0.113.24. A GitHub org 'acme-robotics' hosts 4 public repos, with top contributor 'dpaulson-acme'; the acme-firmware repo names Diana Paulson as a contact. The email diana.paulson@acme-robotics.io appears in the 2021 DevForum breach (hash only).

Coverage: Censys and Shodan were not queried (no key set), so no port/service posture is asserted. Confidence: medium — findings are consistent but rest on a small number of sources.
